title: hylorhipsalis pacheco-leonis subsp. catenulata

This plant has been reported to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hylorhipsalis pacheco-leonis subsp. catenulata include wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
